title: Tiki Cruises

services.name: Private Tiki Boat Cruise
services.desc: Explore the beautiful waters of Cocoa Beach and Merritt Island on a fun and unique boat! Minimum is 2 People $30 per person per hour Choose the time and duration that works best for you! If you do not see an option that accommodates your request please call us and we will do our best to accommodate your needs! 361-929-8357 2 hour minimum Last boat back by dark About Tiki Cruises offers private and public, captained boat tours and one day cruises for up to six people in the beautiful waters of the Cocoa Beach – Merritt Island area. Activities include dolphin /manatee/nature watching, Most popular • Up to 6 guests • BYOB!

includes: Activities include dolphin /manatee/nature watching, music, dancing, grilling, BYOB, frozen drinks, swimming, games, and relaxing in a double hammock.
gap: In case of bad weather, tours can be re-scheduled or refunded.
